A few good questions.

Is this a real store?

No. FORMA is an independent portfolio concept with fictional products, prices and specifications. You can explore the product, build a bag and download a sample order. Nothing is purchased.

What works in this demonstration?

Interactive 3D rotation and zoom, set selection, quantity limits, cart editing, delivery calculations, browser-local persistence and sample order export. The cart stores no personal or payment information.

What would a production launch need?

A product catalogue and inventory source, secure checkout, payment and tax configuration, delivery rules and real product content. Those integrations are outside this frontend demonstration.

Where is my bag saved?

In this browser on this device. It is not shared with another device or an account. If storage is unavailable, the bag works for the current page session.
